attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Mississippi state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure (0% up to $10k, 4.4% above) per MS tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Mississippi Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate MS tax - Single filer (progressive: 0% up to $10k, 4.4% above)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ms_standard_deduction_single sub result.ms_personal_exemption sub 0 max /ms_taxable_income xdef
0 /ms_tax xdef
ms_taxable_income result.ms_bracket_1_limit gt { ms_taxable_income result.ms_bracket_1_limit sub result.ms_bracket_2_rate mul ms_tax add /ms_tax xdef } if
ms_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Mississippi tax (Single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate MS tax - MFJ (progressive: 0% up to $10k, 4.4% above)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ms_standard_deduction_joint sub result.ms_personal_exemption 2 mul sub 0 max /ms_taxable_income xdef
0 /ms_tax xdef
ms_taxable_income result.ms_bracket_1_limit gt { ms_taxable_income result.ms_bracket_1_limit sub result.ms_bracket_2_rate mul ms_tax add /ms_tax xdef } if
ms_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Mississippi tax (MFJ) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Mississippi military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for all military retirement income (Group B). MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize MS military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "MS Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Full exclusion - 100% of military retirement pay excluded from MS taxable income
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay get /result.ms_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
result.ms_subtractions get result.ms_military_retirement_exclusion get add /result.ms_subtractions xdef
"MS Military Retirement Exclusion (Full): $" result.ms_military_retirement_exclusion get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_postfix: 0 /result.ms_military_retirement_exclusion xdef "MS Military Retirement Exclusion: None (no military retirement pay)" job.audit_trail swap addto
